_about: The game has a plushie faction, where cards are essentially stuffed animal versions of existing cards. So that means that if the original card doesn't have any artwork, there's no reference to work from, so it's impossible to draw an accurate plushie version of it.
Blood Imp: Plush Blood Imp is drawn from this card, so it needs art first.
